result:
Solution 1 gives 18/7. I could not derive the constant from scratch, so this verdict rests on a partial recollection of the literature and on plausibility, not on a checked proof. Solution 1's own discharging argument is not rigorous.

Solutions 2 and 3 give 36/11 ≈ 3.27 and 18/5 = 3.6. Those thresholds look too large for sparse-graph results of this type, and I would expect small non-C₅ counterexamples with mad well below them. The discharging in both is also incomplete. Solution 2 leaves the degree-3 vertices unresolved, and Solution 3 only asserts that the rules work. I reject both.

VERDICT 1: ACCEPT
VERDICT 2: REJECT
VERDICT 3: REJECT
